summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K with exhibits related to an underwriting agreement and pricing agreement for an issuance of $1.25 billion 4.983% senior callable fixed-to-fixed reset rate notes due 2032. The notes were issued under an indenture with The Bank of New York Mellon as trustee. This is a routine debt offering by the registrant as issuer, not a special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.
